ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is known that $O$ is a point on the line $AB$, $\angle COD = 90^\circ$, and $OE$ bisects $\angle BOC$. If $\angle AOC = \alpha$, what is the degree measure of $\angle DOE$ (expressed in an algebraic expression involving $\alpha$)?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given the problem, \\
$\because \angle AOC=\alpha$, \\
$\therefore \angle BOC=180^\circ-\alpha$, \\
$\because OE$ bisects $\angle BOC$, \\
$\therefore \angle COE=\frac{1}{2}\angle BOC=90^\circ-\frac{\alpha}{2}$, \\
$\because \angle COD=90^\circ$, \\
$\therefore \angle DOE=90^\circ-(90^\circ-\frac{\alpha}{2})=\boxed{\frac{\alpha}{2}}$.
